mapper.select: SELECT id, name, location, warn_level, danger_level, status, created_at, updated_at FROM station WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO station (name, location, warn_level, danger_level, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{location}, #{warnLevel}, #{dangerLevel}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE station SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
